CanBeGeneratedInCombat.rationale: `public override bool CanBeGeneratedInCombat => false` (Alchemize.cs:12) == the class attribute, which `CardModel.CanBeGeneratedInCombat`'s sim mirror (cards/base.py:96) documents as the FilterForCombat gate used by Infernal Blade / Discovery / Jack of All Trades.

CanonicalKeywords.rationale: Single-element list `{ CardKeyword.Exhaust }` (Alchemize.cs:14) == `exhausts = True`. No Ethereal/Innate/Retain/Unplayable on either side.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Alchemize.cs:16-19) == cost 1 / SKILL / RARE / SELF.

OnPlay.rationale: The entire body is potion procurement -- `PotionCmd.TryToProcure(PotionFactory.CreateRandomPotionInCombat(Owner, Rng.CombatPotionGeneration).ToMutable(), Owner)` (Alchemize.cs:24). Potions are out of scope entirely per the shared contract (deferred by Perry). Recorded for completeness: the sim DOES take the generation draws on the correct named stream when one exists (`rng_set.combat_potion_generation`, colorless_skills.py:43-48) and falls back to the unseeded shared `combat._rng` only when `rng_set is None` (50-52), and it reproduces the create-then-maybe-drop order (`add_potion` returns False on a full belt, player.py:107) that keeps the stream moving on a full belt. The animation trigger (Alchemize.cs:23) is presentation.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `EnergyCost.UpgradeBy(-1)` (Alchemize.cs:29) == `self._energy_cost = max(0, self._energy_cost - 1)`: 1 -> 0 on both sides, and the clamp is never reached from base cost 1. Downgrade is safe here -- `_init_vars` re-seeds `_energy_cost`, so `card_probes.py downgrade` does not list alchemize.

guards.what: PotionCmd.TryToProcure silently drops the potion when the belt is full, AFTER the generation draws (Alchemize.cs:24)
guards.rationale: Potions out of scope. The sim's comment at colorless_skills.py:38-41 states the same create-then-drop ordering, and `Player.add_potion` (player.py:107-112) mirrors `AddPotionInternal`'s `IndexOf(null)` failure mode, so no divergence is visible even though the area is waived.
